answer_1.quote: For pretraining, we apply CompAct to LLaMA-based models of various sizes and train on the C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus) dataset, a commonly used dataset for training large-scale language models.

answer_2.quote: Total training tokens are shown in the last row. As can be seen, CompAct reduces peak memory by up to 17% for LLaMA 350M, with comparable perplexity to baseline.
